bills.title: Ovarian Cancer IMPACT Act
bills.latest_action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

evidence.target_passage: Short title This Act may be cited as the Ovarian Cancer Improving and Modernizing Prevention, Access, Care, and Testing Act or the Ovarian Cancer IMPACT Act . Findings Congress finds the following: Ovarian cancer remains one of the deadliest gynecologic cancers and is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage. Early recognition of symptoms, access to genetic counseling and testing, and timely referral to specialized care can improve outcomes for individuals diagnosed with ovarian cancer. Significant disparities persist in access to gynecologic oncology services, genetic counseling, hereditary cancer risk assessment, and specialty care, particularly in rural and medically underserved communities. Advances in genetic and genomic science present significant opportunities to improve prevention, early detection, treatment selection, and survivorship outcomes. Hereditary cancer syndromes
